subject: Action: Pipeline freshen & SKU normalization before Q2 forecast lock
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-retail.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action: Pipeline freshen & SKU normalization before Q2 forecast lock

Hi Maria / Marcus,

We need a quick cleanup of the Acme pipeline items that are in play for Q2 so the FP&A forecast can lock next Friday (2027-03-26). Short checklist below — aim to have updates in CRM by end of day Wednesday (2027-03-23):

- Confirm "Amount" matches the proposed list price + any negotiated discounts (field: Opportunity:amount)
- Verify Product/SKU field is set to the canonical SKU (we still have mixed free-text product names)
- Update "Next Step" with a clear owner and date (format: Owner — action — due)
- Set Probability to reflect current commit level (30/60/90) and leave a 1-sentence rationale in internal notes

I've attached an initial SKU mapping (SKU-mapping-v2.xlsx) — Marcus, can you validate mappings for regional product codes? Maria, please confirm if Acme will use a single billing SKU or split by region.

If anyone needs a small working session I can jump on 30m tomorrow. We just need consistent fields so Finance can run sensitivity scenarios without manual fixes.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: SKU-mapping-v2.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 32KB)

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-retail.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Action: Pipeline freshen & SKU normalization before Q2 forecast lock

Hi Neha,

Thanks — appreciate the heads-up. We're doing a pricing review this week; I'll confirm whether billing will be consolidated to one SKU or split by fulfillment center.

Quick answers:
- We can confirm list pricing but discounts are negotiated at the contract stage — I'll add a short note to each active opp where terms are in discussion.
- For a handful of opps the product name was free-texted; Marcus, cc'd, will send our internal mapping.

I can get the first pass done by EOD Wednesday. If we run into PO timing issues, I'll loop in AP (accounts-payable@acme-retail.com).

Best,
Maria Gomez
Director, Platform Partnerships
Acme Retail
maria.gomez@acme-retail.com

Neha / Maria — taking point on SKU mapping. I reviewed SKU-mapping-v2.xlsx and found three regional variants we should normalize to the master SKU. I'll attach a CRM playbook with the exact fields and sample text for notes so sellers can paste rather than free-text.

Quick notes:
- Opportunites A-237 and A-245 currently have amounts in local currency; I'll convert and add a conversion note in the internal comments (Opportunity:internal_notes).
- There are two opps without an assigned "Next Step" owner. I suggest temporary assignment to the responsible AE with a 48h due date; they can reassign once the contract team confirms PO cadence.

I'll push a cleaned CSV to the shared drive tonight and tag the HubSpot deal IDs.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | x-3234

Subject: Re: Action: Pipeline freshen & SKU normalization before Q2 forecast lock

Perfect — Marcus, appreciate the playbook. To keep Finance happy, please ensure the following in the clean CSV you upload:

- Column A: HubSpot deal id (format: ACME-###)
- Column B: canonical_SKU
- Column C: amount_usd (rounded to nearest dollar)
- Column D: probability_percent (30/60/90)
- Column E: next_step_owner (full name)
- Column F: next_step_due (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Column G: internal_notes (one sentence rationale)

I'll run a quick validation script on our side once the CSV is live. If we see more than 5% variance vs. last week's commit amounts Finance will flag for manual review and we risk missing lock. Evelyn — FYI / can you confirm we have headcount to support manual cleanups if needed?

Thanks all — target to have status confirmed by EOD Wednesday so Forecast team can ingest Thursday morning.

Neha

All — thanks for moving quickly. I can reallocate two CS analysts to help with manual fixes if Marcus' cleanup shows >5% variance. Please do the following by COB Wednesday:

- Marcus: share the cleaned CSV link in the ticket (FORE-3245) and drop a short summary in the HubSpot deal notes.
- Neha: run the validation and push any throws to the "manual review" pipeline tag.
- Maria: if PO timing looks like it will push beyond our forecast lock, mark the opp "at risk" and set probability to 30 until PO confirmed.

I'll escalate to Finance if we hit the manual review threshold. Appreciate the clear checklist — that made it easy to triage.

Evelyn Hart
